tools.name: ewc_search
tools.description: Search the UK List of Waste by material words, one or more codes, or a code prefix. Returns official entries, hazardous and mirror status, partner codes, source lineage and any assessment needed. Use the returned entries as candidates: origin, process and composition still determine the classificati

tools.name: first_aid_requirements
tools.description: Estimate workplace first-aid cover for each shift from HSE guidance, with EYFS and education guidance where relevant. Returns recommended roles, training, shortages, practical steps, factors and source lineage. This starts a workplace needs assessment; it is not a statutory staffing quota.

tools.name: havs_daily_exposure
tools.description: Calculate one person’s daily hand-arm vibration exposure as A(8), HSE points and low/high range. For each tool, supply a measured vibration magnitude in m/s² or an HSE category and variant returned by power_tool_types. Time means actual tool-running time in the person’s hands.

tools.name: noise_daily_exposure
tools.description: Calculate one person’s daily LEP,d and optional weekly LEP,w from measured task LAeq or dosemeter readings. Optionally assesses peak dB(C) and sound at the ear from SNR or HML protection data. Do not use sound power LwA or per-shot values; omitted peak or protection measurements remain explicitly un

tools.name: construction_injury_statistics
tools.description: Return a retained HSE series for construction deaths, non-fatal injuries or ill health in Great Britain. Preserves each series’ period, units, provisional or revised status, confidence intervals, source file and publication date. This does not query a live HSE feed.

tools.name: power_tool_types
tools.description: List available power-tool type slugs, or return aggregate vibration and declared noise spreads for one type. A selected type also includes mapped HSE vibration variants and HSE in-use noise comparisons where available. It does not return maker-model rows or quotes; declared LpA is not measured task

tools.name: waste_paperwork
tools.description: Return waste-paperwork requirements for a named document, or choose the UK route from jurisdiction and hazardous status. A document id takes precedence when both forms are supplied. Results cover parties, required items, retention, electronic and signature status, regulator route and source lineage.

tools.name: start_document
tools.description: Return an anonymous ComplyOnSite URL for a waste transfer note, hazardous waste consignment note or RAMS flow. Waste-note links prefill validated EWC codes; RAMS links select a job and optional supported operation. The tool does not create, save, sign, issue or submit a document.
